n2dd0802d473.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the pre-2022 regional grouping of Andhra Pradesh's 13 districts?
o: North Andhra comprised Srikakulam, Vizianagaram and Visakhapatnam.
Rayalaseema comprised Kurnool, Kadapa, Anantapur and Chittoor.
Guntur, Prakasam and Nellore were part of North Andhra.
Kadapa is also known as YSR district.
n2dd0802d473.x: Guntur, Prakasam and Nellore were placed in Coastal Andhra, not North Andhra; the other statements are correct.

n7118aa96c15.s: Which of the following pairs about the Special Category Status (SCS) debate for Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
o: PM's promise of SCS – Lok Sabha
End of general-versus-special distinction – Thirteenth Finance Commission
Alternative offered instead of SCS – Special assistance measure
n7118aa96c15.x: A special assistance measure was offered instead of SCS. The PM promised SCS in the Rajya Sabha in February 2014, and it was the Fourteenth Finance Commission that ended the distinction.

ncb8cffb5537.s: The Gentlemen's Agreement, which reused the Sri Bagh template for Telangana safeguards, was concluded in:
ncb8cffb5537.x: The Gentlemen's Agreement was concluded in 1956, not 1969; the Sri Bagh Pact was of 1937.

n9db921f2dd0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the causes of youth unrest?
o: Identity crisis among youth is a cause of youth unrest.
The generation gap is growing as families become nuclear.
Families in India are increasingly becoming nuclear.
The generation gap is shrinking as families become nuclear.
n9db921f2dd0.x: The identity crisis and generation gap grow, not shrink, as Indian families become nuclear.

ncca44b35941.s: The new pattern of youth protest, as in Bangladesh 2024, is typically organised:
o: Under a formally constituted central committee
Through youth wings of political parties
ncca44b35941.x: The new pattern is leaderless, digital protest organised on encrypted apps, with no formal central committee.

ne60f67833aa.s: The Nav Nirman movement of 1974 was a student agitation in:
ne60f67833aa.x: Nav Nirman was a Gujarat student agitation that forced CM Chimanbhai Patel to resign; JP led the separate Bihar movement.

na02ad0fc144.s: How many priority areas does the National Youth Policy 2014 have?
na02ad0fc144.x: NYP 2014 has 5 objectives and 11 priority areas, including participation in politics and governance and sports.

n92e400e1091.s: The NEET paper leak protests, which began at Jantar Mantar and turned nationwide, were followed by:
o: A Supreme Court ban on protests at Jantar Mantar
n92e400e1091.x: The protests began at Jantar Mantar, turned nationwide and were followed by a ministerial resignation (5 Aug 2026).

nd3a541de4a0.s: Which case held Section 309 IPC, punishing attempted suicide, invalid in 1994?
nd3a541de4a0.x: P. Rathinam (1994) held Section 309 invalid; Section 309 made attempted suicide punishable with imprisonment up to one year and/or fine.

n73d22e9b25c.s: In which year did the Delhi High Court decriminalise begging in Delhi in the case associated with Harsh Mander?
n73d22e9b25c.x: The Delhi High Court decriminalised begging in 2018; in 2021 the Supreme Court refused to ban begging, calling it a socio-economic problem.

n70bd4fbfaff.s: Under the Indian Penal Code, which act was punishable when attempted but could not be punished when completed?
n70bd4fbfaff.x: Section 309 IPC punished attempted suicide, but a completed suicide cannot be punished; murder, dacoity and kidnapping are punishable either way.

new.s: Which district has the highest per capita income in Andhra Pradesh (2025-26 AE)?
new.x: Visakhapatnam tops per capita income, with Krishna next; Kurnool is the lowest.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about regional disparity in Andhra Pradesh:
1. No Rayalaseema district reaches the State average per capita income.
2. Kurnool has the lowest per capita income.
3. Anantapur receives more rainfall than Srikakulam.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Anantapur gets about 544 mm against up to 1,250 mm in Srikakulam-Vizianagaram.

new.s: The literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh as per Census 2011 was:
new.x: AP's literacy rate in 2011 was 67.35%.

new.s: The Sri Bagh Pact of 1937 was drafted by:
new.x: The Sri Bagh Pact (16 Nov 1937), the first Coastal-Rayalaseema accord, was drafted by Pattabhi Sitaramayya.

new.s: Under the Sri Bagh Pact, Rayalaseema was given the choice of:
o: The capital or the Governor's residence
The High Court or the University
The capital or the High Court
new.x: The Sri Bagh Pact let Rayalaseema choose either the capital or the High Court; Andhra State's capital went to Kurnool in 1953.

new.s: Article 371D, providing the zonal system of local cadres in Andhra Pradesh, was inserted by the:
new.x: The 32nd Amendment, 1973, following the Six Point Formula, inserted Articles 371D and 371E.

new.s: The Six Point Formula for Andhra Pradesh was announced on:
new.x: The Six Point Formula came on 21 September 1973 and led to the 32nd Amendment inserting Article 371D.

new.s: The Jai Andhra movement of 1972 was a reaction to the Supreme Court's decision upholding the:
new.x: The Jai Andhra movement (1972) reacted to the Supreme Court upholding the Mulki rules and sought a separate Andhra.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about separate-state movements in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The Jai Andhra movement started in Coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema.
2. The 2009-14 phase of the Telangana movement led to Telangana State in 2014.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: Jai Andhra began in Coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema, and the 2009-14 Telangana phase produced Telangana State in 2014.

new.s: Which 1969 committee examined the diversion of Telangana's surplus funds to other regions?
new.x: The Bhargava Committee (1969) dealt with Telangana surplus funds; the Wanchoo Committee (1969) dealt with Mulki safeguards.

new.s: The Srikrishna Committee on the Telangana question (December 2010) gave how many options?
new.x: The Justice B.N. Srikrishna Committee (2010) offered six options on the Telangana / united AP question.

new.s: The backward-areas package of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 covers how many districts?
new.x: The package covers 7 backward districts: 4 in Rayalaseema and 3 in North Andhra.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
o: Each backward district gets a grant of Rs 50 crore per year.
The backward districts are 4 in North Andhra and 3 in Rayalaseema.
new.x: The 7 backward districts are 4 in Rayalaseema and 3 in North Andhra, not the reverse.

new.s: Under the 2020 three-capitals plan of Andhra Pradesh, the judicial capital was to be:
new.x: Kurnool was the judicial capital; Visakhapatnam executive and Amaravati legislative.

new.s: About how many people join India's working-age group each year (2021-31)?
new.x: About 9.7 million join the working-age group each year, which feeds jobless-growth unrest.

new.s: A student protest demanding the postponement of an examination is an example of which type of youth unrest?
new.x: Exam postponement is persuasive unrest; a protest against attendance rules is resistance.

new.s: The resource mobilisation theory of youth unrest holds that what matters more than grievances is:
new.x: Resource mobilisation theory stresses tactics and leadership over grievances; relative deprivation is Stouffer's theory.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of youth unrest forms and examples is correctly matched?
new.x: The Dalit Panthers (1972, Maharashtra) are an example of militancy; secessionist movements include Naga, Assam and Khalistan.

new.s: Among the forms of youth unrest, drug abuse is classed as:
new.x: Drug abuse is listed as deviance among the forms of youth unrest.

new.s: Which was the first student-led national movement in India?
new.x: Swadeshi (1905) was the first student-led national movement; Young Bengal was the first youth organisation.

new.s: The Young Bengal movement, India's first youth organisation, was founded by:
new.x: Young Bengal was founded by Derozio.

new.s: The AASU movement (1979-85) ended with the:
new.x: The AASU movement against illegal migrants ended with the Assam Accord of 1985.

new.s: The 'Visakha Ukku – Andhrula Hakku' agitation is associated with the fast of:
new.x: The 1966 agitation for a steel plant at Visakhapatnam saw T. Amrutha Rao's fast and deaths in police firing.

new.s: The Jai Andhra agitation (1972-73) was ended by the:
new.x: Jai Andhra was ended by the Six-Point Formula of 1973.

new.s: Under the National Youth Policy 2003, 'youth' covered which age group?
new.x: NYP 2003 defined youth as 13-35 years; NYP 2014 narrowed it to 15-29.

new.s: India's first National Youth Policy was adopted in:
new.x: The first NYP came in 1988; National Youth Day and the Department of Youth Affairs date from 1985.

new.s: As per Census 2011, youth (15-24 years) formed about what share of India's population?
new.x: Census 2011 counted about 231 million youth (15-24), around 19.1% of the population.

new.s: As per Census 2011, the youth (15-24 years) population of India was about:
new.x: Census 2011 put youth (15-24) at about 231 million.

new.s: As per the PLFS 2025 annual report, India's youth (15-29) unemployment rate was:
new.x: PLFS 2025 put youth unemployment at 9.9%, down from 10.3%; urban 13.6%, rural 8.3%.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh (PLFS 2023-24), the youth unemployment rate was highest among:
new.x: AP's urban female youth unemployment was 29.1%, against an overall 17.5%.

new.s: The neighbourhood Youth Parliament is part of which programme launched in December 2014?
new.x: The National Young Leaders Programme (Dec 2014) includes the Neighbourhood Youth Parliament and National Youth Advisory Council.

new.s: The National Service Scheme (NSS) was started in:
new.x: NSS began in 1969 with the motto 'Not Me But You'.

new.s: According to Durkheim, anomic suicide results from:
new.x: Anomic suicide arises from too little regulation; fatalistic suicide from too much regulation.

new.s: Durkheim's study 'Le Suicide' was published in:
new.x: Durkheim's Le Suicide appeared in 1897.

new.s: Which section of the Mental Healthcare Act 2017 presumes severe stress in a person who attempts suicide?
new.x: Section 115 of the MHCA 2017 presumes severe stress, so there is no trial or punishment and the State must provide care.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about attempted suicide in law:
1. The Law Commission's 210th Report recommended deleting Section 309 IPC.
2. Section 309 IPC provided imprisonment of up to three months.
3. Section 226 of BNS 2023 deals with an attempt to coerce a public servant.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Section 309 provided simple imprisonment up to one year, not three months.

new.s: Which State tops the Social Justice Ministry's state-wise list of beggars?
new.x: West Bengal tops the Ministry of Social Justice's state list of beggars.

new.s: The punitive anti-begging law copied by many States is the:
new.x: The Bombay Prevention of Begging Act, 1959 is the punitive model many States copied.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Anti-Arrack Movement:
1. It was led by neo-literate women of the literacy campaign.
2. It began in Nizamabad district.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only 1 is correct. The movement began in 1992 in Dubagunta village of Nellore district, not Nizamabad.

new.s: The Social Purity Association (1891), a temperance campaign, was founded by:
new.x: R. Venkataratnam Naidu's Social Purity Association (1891) was a temperance campaign, a precedent for anti-liquor activism.

new.s: Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan was initially launched in how many districts?
new.x: NMBA (MoSJE, 15 Aug 2020) began in 272 districts and now covers all.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan – Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat – Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat – Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan – Ministry of Home Affairs
new.x: Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat is run by MoYAS via MY Bharat; NMBA belongs to MoSJE.

new.s: According to the 2019 National Survey on Extent and Pattern of Substance Use, which was the second most-used substance in India?
new.x: Alcohol (14.6%) came first, cannabis (2.8%) second and opioids (2.1%) third.

new.s: The main law in India on sex trafficking is the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act of:
new.x: The Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 is the main law on sex trafficking.

new.s: As per NCRB's Crime in India 2020, how many Anti Human Trafficking Units (AHTUs) existed across States/UTs?
new.x: NCRB reported 696 AHTUs across States/UTs; MHA has funded AHTUs covering all districts.

new.s: Under GO 43 of Andhra Pradesh, the ex gratia paid to families of farmers who die by suicide is:
new.x: AP pays Rs 7 lakh ex gratia to farmer-suicide families under GO 43.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's liquor policy 2024:
1. Retail liquor sale was shifted to private licensees selected by lottery.
2. A 180 ml quarter was priced at Rs 99.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: retail moved to private licensees by lottery, with a Rs 99 price for a 180 ml quarter.

new.s: 'Dharya Sparsa – Operation Flush-Out' against drugs and illegal liquor was launched by the police of which AP district?
new.x: Chittoor Police launched 'Dharya Sparsa – Operation Flush-Out' in July 2026.

new.s: Which body implements the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan?
new.x: The National Institute of Social Defence (NISD), under MoSJE, runs NMBA.
